items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: December 15th, 1944, Mary Lou recorded three numbers for Asch with seven musicians which included ... Eddie Robinson, bass ... and me.

ctx.x: Ralph had signed a contract with R.K.O. which was the biggest theatrical circuit in the country. There were three tap dancers; Blain, Rice and Berry known as the Three Sams; Bessie Dudley, who was a snake hip dancer and the band. Ralph danced and also did a parody on 'Penthouse Serenade'. Ralph was a very handsome light-coloured man and sort of stocky for a tap dancer. He had teamed with a dancer named Eddie Rector who was one of the best that ever wore a pair of dancing shoes. He looked good leading a band and…

The first hop was Chicago and following is a critic that ran in one of the local papers: 'Ralph Cooper and Band hit. Ralph Cooper brought his famous band into Chicago last week for an engagement at the Palace Theater and scored an instant hit. The opening of the show found the theater packed and they drew well throughout the engagement. Ralph had assembled some of New York's best musicians and whipped them into a selling outfit. Cooper directs the band, sings a number or two and does a dance number that equals…
I remember that the film that was showing at the Palace during the week was 'What price Hollywood' starring Constance Bennett.
